officialSchemaWitnesses.implication: PE/PB history is usable; close and fiscal-report-period context are structurally unavailable and must remain explicit FIELD_NOT_AVAILABLE_IN_SOURCE_SCHEMA.

parserRule.prohibition: Schema-level historical absence may not be encoded as numeric zero or inferred fiscal context.

failures.detail: Parser incorrectly required close and fiscal report period for legacy PE/PB-only source.
Fetch failed on 2018-06-01 during concurrent source pressure.
Fetch failed on 2020-06-08 during concurrent source pressure.
Fetch failed on 2021-06-08 during concurrent source pressure.
Fetch failed on 2023-06-20 during concurrent source pressure.
Official endpoint later returned normal OK for representative early-2026 sessions; non-OK state is retried but never silently accepted.

remediation: Version parser semantics by returned fields rather than assuming modern schema for all history.
Serialize annual workflow max-parallel from 2 to 1.
Reduce within-year request batch from 6 dates to 2 dates.
Use up to five bounded transport/status retries with backoff.
Keep source-date mismatch, core schema drift and duplicate-symbol failures non-retryable.
positiveCounterevidence: 2019/2022/2024/2025 completed under the original lane, proving annual R2 architecture itself is viable.
The same new parser reran all 44 modern raw snapshots successfully, proving legacy support did not weaken modern-source integrity.
